projects.title: Wordev
projects.subtitle: Wordle for Developers
projects.description: Full-stack Wordle-inspired game where every word comes from the developer world. Three game modes: Solo (unlimited games), Daily (one shared word per day), and Versus (real-time 1v1 matchmaking with ELO ranking and live opponent progress via WebSockets).

caseStudy.problem: Ship a developer-themed Wordle that also supports fair real-time Versus — live opponent progress and a ranking that actually sticks.
caseStudy.decision: NestJS + Socket.io for Versus rooms, Prisma/PostgreSQL for shared daily + ELO, Vue.js on the client. Server is source of truth (guess validation, state sync).
caseStudy.result: 3 modes in production (Solo / Daily / Versus), 1v1 matchmaking, persistent ELO, live opponent progress. Live at wordev.jfachard.com

projects.title: WorkSpot
projects.subtitle: Mobile App to Find Remote Work Spots
projects.description: Full-stack mobile application for discovering and sharing ideal remote work locations. Features include geolocation, advanced filters, favorites system, reviews, and image uploads via Cloudinary.

caseStudy.problem: Remote workers need spots filtered by Wi‑Fi, outlets, noise — generic maps don't cut it.
caseStudy.decision: Expo + React Native for fast iOS/Android iteration, NestJS/Prisma for the API, Cloudinary for image uploads, geolocation + server-side filters.
caseStudy.result: Full-stack mobile app: spot discovery, favorites, reviews, image upload, geo filters. API stack ready to scale.

projects.title: DevDuel
projects.subtitle: Real-time 1v1 Coding Quiz App
projects.description: Client-server architecture with real-time WebSocket communication. Implemented matchmaking system and multiplayer game management.

caseStudy.problem: Two players racing a coding quiz at the same time — latency, state sync, and matchmaking without heavy infra.
caseStudy.decision: React + Express + Socket.io: ephemeral rooms, FIFO matchmaking, game state pushed to both clients instead of polling.
caseStudy.result: Synced 1v1 duels, working matchmaking, deployed demo. Validated the realtime pattern later reused in Wordev Versus.

projects.title: The Last Key
projects.subtitle: VR Horror Game
projects.description: Developed in a team of 3. VR Escape room gameplay implementation. Asset management and Unity integration.

caseStudy.problem: Ship a playable VR escape room in a small team — interactions, horror pacing, headset perf.
caseStudy.decision: Unity + C# + VR: split game design / assets / integration, Plastic SCM (Unity Version Control) for collab.
caseStudy.result: Playable VR prototype (team of 3): puzzles, atmosphere, asset integration. Focus on collab and VR runtime constraints.

projects.title: Project Management Mobile App
projects.subtitle: Mobile task manager
projects.description: Stack: React-Native and Trello API. Front-end development and API calls.

caseStudy.problem: Use Trello from mobile without rebuilding a backend — consume the existing API cleanly.
caseStudy.decision: React Native + TypeScript, Trello REST (boards, lists, cards), task/project-oriented UI.
caseStudy.result: Working mobile client on Trello: read/manage tasks via the official API.

projects.title: IRC Chat
projects.subtitle: Real-time messaging application
projects.description: MERN Stack with Socket.io. Full-stack implementation (Front-end and Back-end).

caseStudy.problem: IRC-style instant messaging: live messages, rooms, no refresh.
caseStudy.decision: MERN + Socket.io — bidirectional events, MongoDB for persistence, React client.
caseStudy.result: Full-stack realtime chat: rooms, pushed messages, end-to-end MERN ownership.
